displayName: NBD Pro — website lead submit rejected (any 400/403/5xx on submitPublicLead in 1 h)

documentation.content:
submitPublicLead answered 400, 403 or 5xx at least once in the last hour. Every one of those is a homeowner whose lead was NOT saved (the form shows the call/text fallback). Volume is low (a few real submits a month), so a single rejection is worth a look. 429 (rate limit) is excluded; alert-rate-limit-spike covers it.

Why this exists: from 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-25 every submit got 403 turnstile-required (TURNSTILE_REQUIRED=true with TURNSTILE_SECRET still the `__unset__` stub) and nothing alerted, because alert-functions-error-rate needs > 50 ERROR entries in 5 min. Replayed over the previous 30 days this policy fires on 2026-10-29, 11-05, 11-12 and 11-13: every rejected visit, nothing else. documentation/audit/WEB-LEADS-TURNSTILE-OUTAGE-2026-11-25.md.

Investigate:
  gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="submitpubliclead" AND (httpRequest.status>=400 OR severity>=WARNING)' --project nobigdeal-pro --freshness 2h --limit 50 --format 'value(timestamp,httpRequest.status,severity,textPayload,jsonPayload.message)'
The 403 body's reason (turnstile-required = secret missing with the flag on; missing-token = the visitor's browser sent no Turnstile token; anything else = Cloudflare error codes) is also in GA4 as the lead_submit_failed event's server_reason. Fix and rollback: documentation/runbooks/TURNSTILE-SETUP.md "Emergency".
